subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result visibility policy should this PR implement before it can fix https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97651: status/heartbeat-only placeholders, a broader explicit ephemeral contract, or deferral to provider cache-boundary work?
rationale: The patch changes what information the model can see after tools run, and code inspection shows the current broad allowlist is unsafe while the remaining correct allowlist is a product/runtime policy choice.

options.title: Narrow to status and heartbeat outputs
options.body: Require the branch to summarize only maintainer-approved status or heartbeat acknowledgments, rebase onto packages/ai, and add live DeepSeek proof before merge.

options.title: Define a broader explicit contract
options.body: Maintain a broader allowlist only after maintainers specify which tool outputs are safe to hide and add coverage for each tool family.

options.title: Defer to cache-boundary work
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the provider prompt-cache strategy tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95311 instead of hiding tool results.

recommendation.title: Narrow to status and heartbeat outputs
recommendation.body: Require the branch to summarize only maintainer-approved status or heartbeat acknowledgments, rebase onto packages/ai, and add live DeepSeek proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest current history signal for both provider conversion and prompt-cache boundary behavior.
